Welcome—I'm so glad you're joining me on this journey.
Have you ever wondered how deep-rooted ideas can quietly shape the world around us, even when we don't always see them at work?
Together, we're about to explore the enduring threads of white supremacy ideology, and how they’re woven—often invisibly—into everyday life in America.
Drawing from Martha R Bireda’s powerful book, A Time for Change: How White Supremacy Ideology Harms All Americans, we’ll uncover the ways these beliefs ripple through our institutions, our communities, and even our personal relationships.
What if I told you that the impact stretches far beyond those most visibly affected? We're going to look at how these patterns create divisions, distort our sense of connection, and hold us all back—no matter who we are or where we come from.
As we dig into both history and the present moment, you’ll find yourself challenged to see familiar things in a new light, and to question the assumptions that often go unspoken.
This isn’t just about pointing out what’s wrong—it's about discovering how we can move forward, together. Through stories, insights, and honest reflection, we’ll open up the possibility for healing, justice, and a future that includes all of us.
So, are you ready to look deeper and imagine what true change could mean—not just for some, but for everyone? Let’s take the first step, together.
